clips.title: The story
paras: In Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder guides Horde shamans toward the elements.

Inside Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder guides shamans seeking the elements. Many Darkspear trolls commune with spirits through witch doctors and voodoo rituals. Searn guides initiates toward distant mentors and rites for the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air, which teach them to commune with the elemental spirits of fire, water, and air. He stands among the Horde's high command in Orgrimmar.
